description: Training Lab, CRM Studio polish, general skeleton loading states, consistent hover/focus states, and CrmStudio card enhancements. Completes the UI pass. Depends on FEAT-001 for tokens. Independent of FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 with respect to logic, but should come after them to avoid CSS merge conflicts — so it runs sequentially last. All changes are visual-only to index.css, crm-studio.css, TrainingLab.tsx, CrmStudio.tsx, and WorkspaceShared.tsx. No prop or export changes.
steps:
Step 1 — Skeleton loading state utility. Add a reusable skeleton shimmer pattern to index.css: .skeleton { border-radius:6px; background:linear-gradient(90deg, var(--muted) 25%, var(--border) 50%, var(--muted) 75%); background-size:400px 100%; animation:shimmer 1.4s ease-in-out infinite; }. Add skeleton variants: .skeleton-text { height:12px; width:100%; } .skeleton-text.short { width:60%; } .skeleton-text.xs { height:9px; } .skeleton-heading { height:20px; width:55%; } .skeleton-avatar { width:34px; height:34px; border-radius:50%; } .skeleton-card { min-height:120px; border-radius:14px; }. Update WorkspaceShared.tsx: change WorkspaceLoading to render three skeleton rows instead of a spinner: replace the single loading-state div with
. Add .skeleton-list { display:grid; gap:14px; } to index.css.

Step 3 — CRM Studio card polish in crm-studio.css. Update .studio-card: add box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm); transition:box-shadow .18s ease-out;. Update .studio-workspace (template cards): change existing hover state to: .studio-workspace:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); border-color:#558578; box-shadow:var(--shadow-md); }. Add a hover state for regular .studio-card (non-button): .studio-card:not(button):not(.studio-workspace):hover { box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm); }. Enhance .studio-tabs [aria-selected='true']: add background:var(--purple-50); border-radius:8px 8px 0 0; color:var(--purple-700);. Add status badge patterns to crm-studio.css for use in CRM record display: .status-badge { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; padding:3px 9px; border-radius:999px; font-size:10px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.04em; } .status-badge.active { background:var(--green-100); color:var(--green-600); } .status-badge.inactive { background:var(--muted); color:var(--muted-foreground); } .status-badge.pending { background:#fff3e0; color:#c57a00; } .status-badge.error { background:var(--rose-100); color:var(--rose-600); }.

Step 4 — CrmStudio.tsx table and field row enhancements. The studio table (for displaying CRM records) currently uses plain border/padding. In CrmStudio.tsx, find the <table> element (inside .studio-table-wrap) and add className='studio-data-table'. Find the <tr> elements in <tbody> and add className='studio-data-row'. Add to crm-studio.css: .studio-data-table { border-collapse:separate; border-spacing:0; width:100%; font-size:13px; } .studio-data-table th { background:var(--purple-50); color:var(--purple-700); font-size:10px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; padding:10px 14px; border-bottom:2px solid var(--purple-200); } .studio-data-table td { padding:12px 14px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); vertical-align:middle; } .studio-data-row { transition:background .14s ease-out; } .studio-data-row:hover { background:var(--purple-50); } .studio-data-row:last-child td { border-bottom:0; }. For the field rows in the BlueprintEditor (.studio-field-row), add a subtle hover: .studio-field-row:hover { background:var(--muted); border-radius:8px; }.

Step 6 — TwentyGallery.tsx card enter animation. Each .twenty-gallery-card article is static. Add a staggered animation using CSS custom property trick (no JS needed). In crm-studio.css: .studio-grid .studio-card { animation:fadeInUp .3s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1) both; animation-delay:calc(var(--card-index, 0) * 60ms); }. In TwentyGallery.tsx, add style={{ '--card-index': index } as React.CSSProperties} to each
element inside the apps.map(). Also improve the empty state: change the empty-state div to use the standard .empty-state class from index.css (it already does) but add an icon, replacing with a proper .empty-icon wrapper:
.
